Dated-contract variant of CARRY_STAKED_BASIS. stETH margin (ETH-collateral); hedge leg is Deribit dated ETH future. Roll adds expiry risk absent from perp variant — cap set lower (40k vs 50k). Added 2026-05-18 per strategy_archetype_taxonomy §V-1.
CeFi dated-future leg for staked-basis carry. Requires stETH as collateral at CeFi venue — only Deribit / Binance accept stETH as margin collateral today.

Family 2 recursive borrow: lend ETH/stETH on Aave (USDC margin), short USDC-margined perp on Hyperliquid/Bybit to neutralise ETH-correlated delta. Renamed from CARRY_RECURSIVE_BORROW_PERP_HEDGED 2026-05-12. Per defi_recursive_borrow_archetypes §Family-2.

CeFi perp hedge leg (Phase 2): USDC-margined ETH-PERP short sized to E_actual for delta neutrality. Hyperliquid PRIMARY (USDC-margin); Bybit BACKUP capped at <=50% of Hyperliquid notional (Feb-2025 hack counterparty-trust discount, ARCHETYPE_CONCENTRATION_MULTIPLIER). Registry gap closed 2026-07-10 per archetype_venue_universe_cefi_vs_registry_no_cefi_cells_2026_06_30.

Family 1 pure-lending recursive arb: deposit stETH/jitSOL as collateral, borrow USDC, re-deposit into higher-yield lending pool. No perp hedge — full delta exposure to underlying. Per defi_recursive_borrow_archetypes §Family-1. hedge_ratio=None.

Inverse of CARRY_BASIS_DATED: short the basis (lend USDC-margined perp, hold spot). Same cap/gates as CARRY_BASIS_DATED; opposite directional bet. Added 2026-05-18 per strategy_archetype_taxonomy §V-1.
